notice: Project-authored condensed descriptors for every source dimension and score point. Not a verbatim official rubric or validated scoring instrument.

organization_purpose.4: Unified plot; clear setting and narrator/characters, purposeful transitions, logical events and effective opening/closure.
organization_purpose.3: Evident plot and context; mostly coherent events, adequate transitions and opening/closure.
organization_purpose.2: Inconsistent plot or context; uneven transitions and event sequence, weak boundaries.
organization_purpose.1: Little plot or context; disconnected events, few useful transitions and missing boundaries.

development_elaboration.4: Thorough characters/events; effective dialogue, description and other techniques; sensory or figurative language and style advance the story.
development_elaboration.3: Adequately developed characters/events; suitable techniques, details, language and style.
development_elaboration.2: Uneven development and techniques; weak details or language, awkward source connections if used.
development_elaboration.1: Vague events/characters; minimal techniques and details, ineffective language or distracting source connections.

conventions.2: Adequate control of sentence construction, punctuation, capitalization, grammar and spelling.
conventions.1: Partial control; correct conventions are limited.
conventions.0: Little control; correct conventions are infrequent.

scope_notes: Judge convention errors by variety, severity and density; weigh basic errors more heavily.
Explicit point-of-view expectations begin at grade 7. Source connections may enhance a narrative but are not mandatory.
total_policy: Display-only unweighted sum; no cross-provider score conversion or proficiency decision.
not_scorable_policy: Source NS reasons; project policy withholds all dimensions and total for any NS. Off-purpose is NS in the first two source dimensions, not the conventions column.
